records.claim_text: PayrollOrg describes CPO as continuing conversations from its2024/2025 Executive Summits; a January 2026 article reports the invite-only online forum launched in October 2025. This is a publisher-described multi-format development, not a measured event-to-community conversion effect.
records.locator: CPO About retained lines5–9; Forum article launch paragraphs
records.limitations: No evidence that a dinner caused repeat engagement, that the same people attended each format, that members renewed, or that JGA can reproduce the sequence.
records.population: Published offer/output context or explicit researcher application; no original participant data
records.time_period: Dated public materials reviewed30 October 2026; actual event/issue/update dates retained

records.limitations: Archive presence is not verified publication consumption, participant retention, fresh research input or a guaranteed future quarterly commitment. Web reader returned an older archive; original live HTML retained for this claim.

records.claim_text: The Payroll Centre’s materials rules restrict carrying access/materials to a new employer and limit access after membership expiry. This demonstrates that person, organisation, service period and reuse permission can have separate lifecycles.
records.locator: Business terms clauses9.3.3 and9.5.1–9.5.3; retained parsed rights section
records.limitations: Specific provider terms, not a universal rule for councils orJGA. No inference that a practitioner changing jobs necessarily loses professional relevance, or that previously granted publication consent automatically expires.
records.population: Published offer/output context or explicit researcher application; no original participant data
records.time_period: Dated public materials reviewed30 October 2026; actual event/issue/update dates retained

records.claim_text: HR.com’s retained custom-research, recruitment and free-access help articles carry different 2021, 2024 and 2023 update dates. Their chronology supports separate dated statements, not a verified history of offer changes or confirmation of one current combined package.

records.limitations: Do not infer a launch, cancellation, price change or current contract from access/update dates. The concrete2025 sponsored report remains a separate observed output, with no exact-package relationship inferred.

records.claim_text: For The Table, distinguish the lifecycle of a named programme, a particular event cohort, a continuing member relationship and a versioned research-use right. Planned repeat outputs, contract renewal, actual payment, useful participation and permissioned contribution should remain separate evidence states.
records.locator: Analytical application of dated CPO formats and Payroll Centre lifecycle terms
records.limitations: An optional design condition, not a new mandatory questionnaire, retention score, automatic-renewal recommendation or proven causal model. No new Table participant, paid commitment or rights policy is established.
